criteria.requirement: Fix _Error.__init__ to materialize context exactly once and assign parent on the retained children rather than re-iterating the source. Generator/list/tuple and deliberately one-shot iterable inputs must preserve child identities and equal absolute instance/schema paths through multiple ancestors. Apply to both ValidationError and SchemaError/create_from, keep empty contexts and existing list behavior, and introduce no copied child objects or fabricated paths.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
